senses.gloss: (also in one word) pr. n. m. Turnus Rufus (supposed to be a corruption of T. Annius Rufus), a Roman commander in the days of the Hadrianic persecutions.
units: <cite ref="Taanit 29a:14">Taan. 29ᵃ</cite> <cite ref="I00242"><he>טורנסרופוס</he></cite> ed. (Ms. M. <he>טורנוסנורופוס</he>, or <he>טורנוסט׳</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note). Y. Ber. IX, 14ᵇ bot. <he>טונוס טר׳</he> (Tosaf. to <cite ref="Sotah 31a">Sot. 31ᵃ</cite> <he>טורנוסר׳</he>).
